I even tried to run away, but they caught me.
I was scared the bungee cord might snap.

When is she going to hang up?

messages.ko: 순진하고 귀여운 모습을 하고 지들 보스 막 죽이고

Bob is the cutest. He's my favorite.
That might be a bit much...
Paint yourself yellow and wear goggles?

I'm not asking for the clothes.

I can make pretty much anything.

Busy, fast, constantly eating while cooking...

If you could only cook me one dish, what would you make?

.......Let's stop talking about it. I feel too bad.

Has it already been that long?

I need to start exercising again.

messages.ko: 난 운동하면 바로 근육 붙는 스타일이라

Wouldn't your shoulders get even broader?

If I raced Yooyeon, I'd lose...

Doesn't my love fill your stomach?

There are just too many delicious foods in this world.

and send me lots of cute thoughts~ 😘

and now I'm about to pass out.
I want to dye my hair.

My special talent is eating! My hobby is eating! And the thing I like is...

I'll do a two-line acrostic poem with 'Jeong-Me.' Jeong: Jeong HaYeon. Me: Bleh.
Then I'll do a three-line acrostic poem with 'Yuk-Ba-Yeon.'

messages.ko: 애들이랑있을때 진진진짜짜를 쓰니까 애들이 이상하게 쳐다봤어..

messages.ko: 아이들아, 꼭 제때 병원에 가세요! 한 달 전부터 가슴이 아프기 시작했지만, 곧 나아질 거라고 계속 생각해서 미루고 가지 않았습니다. 오늘 의사가 직접 나에게 "왜 이제서야 왔어?"라고 물었고, 지금 내 마음에 정하연이 있다고 말했다.
messages.en: Everyone, make sure you go to the hospital on time! My chest started hurting about a month ago, but I kept putting it off because I thought it'd get better. Today the doctor asked me, 'Why did you only come now?' I told them it's because Jeong HaYeon is in my heart.
then don't go to the hospital.

I'll settle down in your heart.

but when they're out on a walk, it runs around just fine.

HaYeon should learn acting from Coca-Cola.
It looks small, but it's actually really big.
It's not even a year old yet.
Then it probably doesn't even know Hayeon exists.
That's right. I'm still a stranger to it.
I'm going to take a shower.
Hayeon got off work and took a shower.
It's almost my vacation too ㅠㅠ

I haven't had a proper break at all.
I've been thinking about what to do during my vacation.
Maybe go on a trip with my grandma, grandpa, and cousins,
Honestly, I was planning to just sleep the whole time,
but that feels like such a waste.
Are you going to film a Set Log during your vacation???

But I didn't know how to save it.
So I just became someone who filmed really hard...
Seriously, how do you save it?
I'm slowly falling behind the trends now.

In another six months I'll be 21.

I even picked the design myself.
I'm going to the fansign tomorrow,

we always settle the bill afterward.

messages.ko: 애들이랑 맨날 같이 밥먹고 모이고 하니까
messages.en: We eat together and hang out all the time,
so I think it's about time we took a little break before meeting again.
when you don't see each other too often.
We've been together way too much.

I deserve a lot of credit for that.
If you're an '07 line fan, you should thank me.

So Hyerin should buy us a meal sometime.
Then what's the benefit of being the leader?

so once we can send videos, I'll send it to you.
Oops, I accidentally sent the same picture twice.

And Yooyeon unnie was off wandering around taking selfies.

messages.ko: 부럽네 연지가 사진찍고 숨숨이가 영상찍어주는 삶이라니

messages.ko: 웨이브!! 뮤직뱅크1위 축하해!!! 너무너무 고마워 사실 1위하자마자 든 생각은 트리플에스가 해냈다 라는 감정보다 웨이브가 해냈다!! 라는 감정이 더 든것같아 진짜 웨이브가 준 엄청 큰 선물같아 사실 아이돌꿈을 꾸면 제일 이뤄보고싶은건 공중파 음악방송 1위하고 축하받으면서 무대에 서있는 그런 꿈을 많이 꾸잖아 덕분에 이뤄서 너무 행복한 기억 남겼어 ㅎㅎ누군가를 응원한다는 건 생각보다 쉬운 일이 아니잖아 하루의 시간을 내서 무대를 봐주고 투표해주고 좋은 말을 남겨주고 내 일처럼 같이 기뻐하고 같이 속상해해 주는 거 정말 온마음을 다해 고마워 그리구 결과가 좋을 때만 함께하는 사이가 아니라 어떤 순간에도 서로를 믿어주고 응원하는 관계가 있다는 게 얼마나 소중한 일인지 알게 해줘서 너무 고마워 웨이브가 준 큰 선물 앞으로 계속 같이히면서 보답할게 트리플에스가!! 사랑해~~
messages.en: Wav!! Congratulations on getting Music Bank 1st place!!! Thank you so, so much. Honestly, the first thing I thought when we won wasn't 'tripleS did it'—it was more like 'Wav did it!!' It really felt like such a huge gift from Wav. When you dream of becoming an idol, one of the biggest dreams is standing on stage after getting 1st place on a public music show and receiving congratulations, right? Thanks to you, I got to experience that. It became such a happy memory for me. Supporting someone isn't actually an easy thing. Taking time out of your day to watch performances, vote, leave kind messages, celebrate like it's your own achievement, and feel sad together... I'm truly thankful with all my heart. And thank you for showing me how precious it is to have a relationship that isn't only there for good results, but one where we trust and support each other no matter what moment we're in. I'll keep repaying this huge gift Wav gave us by staying together moving forward. tripleS will!! I love you~~

messages.ko: 그리고 오늘 진짜 울뻔했는데 안구건조증때문에 안에서 나오진 않더라

messages.ko: 역시 마법소녀라 무적일 줄 알았어🥹🥹🥹푹 쉬구 낼 건강하게 만나자 하연아🥹🥹🥹
messages.en: I knew a magical girl would be invincible. 🥹🥹🥹 Get plenty of rest, and let's meet tomorrow healthy, Hayeon. 🥹🥹🥹

that make your heart flutter the most, you dummy. ㅎ

messages.ko: 나는 너 만나서 진짜 행복했어 지금까지
messages.en: Meeting you has made me genuinely happy all this time.
You'll be even happier from now on.
Shall we have a Haranghae time? ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I worship Jeong Hayeon, the woman who makes me happy.
That sounds like a line from a youth drama.
But don't actually bring it on.
Just pretend to challenge me, World!!!
I have to wake up early tomorrow!
Please take good care of me.
I spent the countdown with the 07z.
"It's our year!!! We're going to crush it!!!"
We were going to watch the sunrise too.
But when we went outside, it was freezing.
So we immediately ran back to the heated blanket.
All four of us jumped under it.
We also did a gift exchange!!
Mine was a custom keycap with '20❤️' on it.
And that ugly doll with teeth.
Those were the gifts I bought.
And I received what Hyerin prepared.
And a charger cap from Crayon Shin-chan.
Chaewon received bath bombs from Soomin.

messages.ko: 혜린이는 채원이가 준비한 애기동화책이랑 신라면양말 받음
messages.en: Hyerin received a children's storybook and Shin Ramyun socks from Chaewon.
I really feel like the 07z have become even closer.
Now I can't use the 'Did you meet a minor?' joke anymore.
I guess nobody has to turn themselves in at the police station anymoreㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹ.
Now you can come over to my side~

messages.ko: 언니 저 아직 미성년자인데 저랑 만나신거에요..?
messages.en: Unnie, I'm still a minor... does that mean you met with me?
So... I'm the police station now?
Then none of you have managed to leave yet.
I was going to eat tteokguk today.
I can keep saying I'm still 19~
If age is based on how many bowls of tteokguk you've eaten, I'm over 100 years old.
So I still wear my school uniform.
So I'm a student for one more month.
I'm on vacation right now though.
The others still have to go to school.

messages.ko: 20살 되니까 달라진 거 있는 거 같아??
messages.en: Does anything feel different now that you're 20?
Honestly, it still doesn't feel real.
It's just... another day has passed?
I can go to a PC bang late at night now???
Now you can finally transfer outㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ.
I don't have to leave first anymore.
I somehow like the number already.
Seeing myself become an adult, something that felt like it'd never happen...

messages.ko: 그냥 눈 깜빡하면 서른 돼있을것 같아
messages.en: I feel like I'll blink and suddenly be thirty.
How long was I asleep for!!!!
No wonder I felt so dry.
I think I'll need an entire bottle of face mist.

messages.ko: 동결 건조면 동그란 볼 바싹 말랐나?
messages.en: If you're freeze-dried, do your round cheeks shrivel up too?
Would you still love me even if I were freeze-dried...?
Would you still love me if I became an Avatar?

messages.ko: 그럼 넌 육각단들이 아바타가 돼도 사랑해줄거야???
messages.en: Then would you still love the Hexagons if they became Avatars too?

messages.ko: 그럼 나도 캡슐 들어가서 아바타 해야지
messages.en: Then I'll go into one of those capsules and become an Avatar too.
But somehow made it even more wrong.
Now I want to eat some.
Didn't you say you were starting a diet!
Tteokguk doesn't make you gain weight... ㅎㅎㅎ
I really am going to lose weight.
I'll just enjoy this one meal~
Tell me the first song you listened to this New Year before you go.
It's the last day of my teenage years.
Hayeon will become an adult in six hours...
I also bought gifts for the 07z.
We promised to keep them a secret from each other.
Then I'll tell you all about them.
And another one is like a keyring.
It's not something you eat thoughㅋㅋㅋㅋ.
We're meeting up later to do the countdown together.
I'll see them in a little while.
I think there are going to be so many people.
It's going to be like *Where's Waldo?*
I hope you receive lots of New Year's blessings.
Please accept my New Year's bow.
Ah haha, wasn't it supposed to be twice~? Haha.

messages.ko: 두번 하면 나는……. 새해를 맞이하지 못하겠지
messages.en: If you bow twice... I probably won't make it to the New Year.
I loved with all my heart.
Next year, I'll love you even more passionately.
Do our best next year too.
I look a bit more mature than when we first met, don't I?
Hayeon-unnie... I don't think it's just liking you anymore. I think I genuinely love you. It feels like I can't live without you, and I get lovesick.
Does anyone know how to fix that?

messages.ko: 나도 몰라서 계속 저렇게 살고 있어..
messages.en: I don't know either, so I've just been living like this...

messages.ko: 아이돌이 딸 같은 건 어떡해야 함.. 내가 키워야할 거 같고 육아통? 오는 거
messages.en: What do I do if my idol feels like my daughter... Like I have to raise you and I get parenting pains?

messages.ko: 그건 진짜 영원해야 한다는 뜻 아닐까
messages.en: Doesn't that mean it has to last forever?
After talking on Fromm like this today...
If I come back exactly on January 1st...
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ I'd probably puff up a lot.
I can't believe I'm turning twenty...
Please send one last 19-year-old Jeong Hayeon voice message...
Wait, you went without even making a reservation?
It's still slow even if you make one!!!!
We probably would've gone straight in as VIPs.
I'm going to enjoy my meal.
I'll go eat and come back.
For the last time this year...
I ate 30,000 won worth of malatang and guobaorou.
Then I got hit with a blood sugar spike and completely crashed.
I think I need to finish an entire bottle of apple cider vinegar...
I ate it all by myself.
Wow, I almost died from how full I was.
Bulking up for the New Year?
I make this resolution every January 1st...
But this time I'm seriously starting my diet.
I'm even going to keep a diary.
This time I really mean it.
"How does it feel to become an adult?"
Honestly, it doesn't feel like anything huge is changing.

messages.ko: 사실 새해를 맞이하는 기분이 어떻냐 물어보는게
messages.en: So I think it's actually easier to answer if someone asks how it feels to welcome the New Year...
...than asking how it feels to become an adult.
The first digit of my age is changing...
Now, when people ask how old I am...
I'll have to say I'm in my twenties.
Talking about it just now suddenly made it feel real.
So 19-year-old S19 Jeong Hayeon is leaving too...
I didn't get to do that concept very much though...ㅠㅠ
The way they play, the way they talk...
It's like they're still stuck in middle schoolㅋㅋㅋ.
She still feels like she'd be whining about having to wear a tie and go to school.
They really do say, 'Speak of the tiger and it appears.'
Soomin, are you subscribed to my Fromm?
So you were one of the Hexagons after all.
I watched the year-end awards ceremony video.
I watched it together with Nakyoung-unnie.
Everyone looked so elegant and pretty sitting there.

messages.ko: 나 혼자 컴퓨터 하루종일 하다 온사람처럼
messages.en: Meanwhile, I was the only one who looked like I'd just spent the whole day sitting in front of a computer.
"Why does this kid look so boiled?"
Honestly, I thought you looked the most elegant.
But this time I got nominated for the Variety Award and the Best Couple Award.
Last year I seriously had nothing for the Best Couple Award.
There would've been at least something.
So I had my hopes up.
But since I was nominated this year...
I'll just go do my skincare...
Congratulations on spending midnight together with Hayeon!
It's the last Monday of the year?
It makes me want to give meaning to everything...
I think I need to take it again.
I said I'm NOT an INFP!!!!!
Now all the INFPs are mad at me...

messages.ko: ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 인프피 그런 거 서운해 함
messages.en: ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ INFPs get hurt by things like that.
You're not going to keep that bottled up until next year, are you~?
I just don't think I am one.
But ENFP doesn't feel right either.
I don't know. I should take the test again.
Then I won't be able to message you for 30 minutesㅋㅋㅋ.
I said to one of the members,
"So I went to the hospital and got tested."
I was like, 'What's with this kid?'
It was either Hyerin or Yeonji.
I was like, 'Of course I was joking... what do you mean?'
They said they thought MBTI had become so advanced...
That hospitals had started offering MBTI tests.
Like at counseling centers or places like thatㅋㅋㅋㅋ.
I mean... that kind of makes sense.
Maybe I made it sound too believable.
It feels like we were given one extra day.
Wow... I really felt called out.
I'll try to hold myself back.
Thank you for spending this year together with me...
Out of this vast universe, we found each other.
I won't go that far... haha.

messages.ko: 난 이번년도가 정말 많은감정이 든 한해였던거같아
messages.en: I think this year was filled with so many emotions.
Of course there were times when I was angry and sad.
There were also times when I was overflowing with happiness and joy.

messages.ko: 근데 지금 이렇게 무사히 같이 이번년도를
messages.en: But being able to safely spend this year together like this...
Is what I'm most grateful for.
I've really tried to keep every promise I've made.
I truly worked hard to do that.

messages.ko: 말로만 잘할게 노력할게 늘어올게 하는사람 되기 싫어서
messages.en: Because I never wanted to be someone who only says, 'I'll do better,' 'I'll work harder,' or 'I'll improve,' without actually following through.
I wanted to become someone that **Y/n** could be proud to like.
Someone who wouldn't fall behind wherever she goes.
Someone you could proudly talk about, without feeling like I was lacking in any way.
So I've always tried my best.

messages.ko: 그 노력이 남들한테 잘 보여지지 않았더라도
messages.en: Even if that effort wasn't obvious to other people...

messages.ko: 늘 옆에서 응원해주고 알아주고 힘을 줘서 진짜 고마웠어
messages.en: Thank you so much for always cheering me on, recognizing my efforts, and giving me strength.

messages.ko: 작은 말한마디 한마디에 진짜 많이 힘 얻었고
messages.en: Even your smallest words gave me so much strength.
They made me think that I should work even harder.
Thanks to that, I've been able to accomplish so many things.
I can't express it with just the words 'thank you.'
Next year, I'll continue to be a hardworking Hayeon, just like I was this year.
I'll do my best so there won't be anything for you to worry about.
I want you to clearly see just how hard I'm working.
Next year, and the year after that too...
That was everything I truly wanted to say, and my aspiration going forward.
Thank you for becoming someone so precious to me. ❤️
Take all of the New Year's luck~
I won't keep putting too much pressure on myself...
Or make myself stressed while doing everything. So don't worry.
Let's both do our best together.
Make your own happiness your number one priority, Hayeon.

messages.ko: 내가 혹시나 부족한 모습이나 힘들어하는모습이 보이면
messages.en: If you ever see me struggling or not being my best...
Please stay by my side and cheer me on.
I should slowly get some sleep now.
Sleep well, and let's both do our best tomorrow. ❤️
I was hanging out with Chaeyeon-unnie...
I showed her Mankey's kicking move.
She told me to go away.
Unnie suddenly said she bought Pokémon cards.
I looked at them and Mankey looks so funny.
Oh right, I have something to brag about.
I appeared in the same frame as Gosegu-nim and Ine-nim.
Maybe my dream was a prophetic dream.
But something also made me really angry.
I told one of the members...

messages.ko: 나 이세계아이돌분들이랑 챌린지 찍었어!!!! 부럽지 ㅋ케케키키키
messages.en: "I filmed a challenge with Isegye Idol!!!! Jealous? ㅋㅋㅋ"
They move and talk themselves... cartoon?
That's insulting to them and to the fans, including me.
Did you have a good Christmas??
They said a cold wave started.
But I met up with a friend in this freezing weather.
I had a really good rest.
And that's how my vacation ended...
Is Taxi Driver good? I haven't watched it.
It's the kind of drama that teaches you things.
Feels like it's explaining things to you.
Makes it feel like you're learning new knowledge.
Pull the seatbelt all the way out.
Or check between the rubber seals.
See if there's mud in places like that.
That's what they said to check.
And if you want to become friends with a yakuza boss...
That's the kind of content it has.
But you have to fight better than the boss.

messages.ko: 나같은 경우엔 흑염룡이 있기 때문에 가능임
messages.en: For me it's possible because I have the Black Flame Dragon.
I can still smell Chaeyeon-unnie's perfume.
I should ask what perfume it is.
What are you even misunderstanding? Anyway...
Is your skin doing better now?
This has never happened to me before.
Having my skin break out like this...

messages.ko: 그거 걍 기초에서 문제가 잇을 수도 잇음 유수분 밸런스 잘 맞춰서 스킨케어해봐
messages.en: It might just be your basic skincare. Try balancing your skin's oil and moisture.
Wow, you sound like a professional.
I recently splurged on skincare products.
Is it bad if I apply too much?
I used to be really confident in my skin.
So I barely put anything on.
How many products are you using?
Why are you using so many calming products?
Because I desperately want it to calm down...
Oh... Then what did you do before?
Before, I just used whatever cream.
Sometimes I'd even use body lotion.
Then the rest on my body.
"Take care of your skin while it's still good."
I thought my skin would always stay fine.
But lately, with all my schedules...
Maybe I should stop wearing base makeup for schedules.
Even your face after waking up from sleeping 10 hours is cute.
It'd be hard to look at.
She made them herself and gave me some.
She even went to the market herself.
Bought all the ingredients and made them.
I'm even writing her a letter.
Have you ever tried baking too?
Of course, they all burst though.
But I'm a Korean food master.
I'm good at Western food too.
I'm telling you, I even made the roux.
I've been watching Please Take Care of My Refrigerator lately.
I think I'd do well if I went on the show.
But my magic would be a different kind.

messages.ko: 김풍님은 허겁지겁 얼렁뚱땅 만드는것처럼 보이지만 결과물은 항상 훌륭하신 매직
messages.en: Kim Poong-nim's magic is that it looks rushed and sloppy, but the final result is always amazing.

messages.ko: 하연이는 15분 되기도 전에 완벽하게 만들어놔서 모두가 감탄하지만 맛은 없는 매직
messages.en: Hayeon Magic is making everything look perfect before the 15 minutes are even up, everyone is amazed... but it doesn't taste good.

messages.ko: 망키 발로차기가 지 능력이라고 거기 써있는게 너무 웃기지 않아?
messages.en: Isn't it hilarious that Mankey's ability is literally listed as 'kicking'?
Hayeon, can we moe-ify you as Mankey? I think you look alike.
I shouldn't have brought it up...;;
My number one pick is Squirtle.
Don't even bring up anything else~❤️
What about Mankey... Mankey will be sad...
Even Mankey being sad would be cute!
Don't start bringing up Pokémon I don't know!!
If I search them and they're some huge buff monster...
Anyone mentioning weird ones from now on is Jynx.
Hayeon, you're really good at Korean.

messages.ko: 하 이런 초딩이 어떻게 일주일 뒤에 성인일 수가 있는거지 ;
messages.en: How is this elementary school kid becoming an adult in a week?

messages.ko: 아니 근데 진짜 오래 잤어? 너무 안 자서 착각하는 거 아니야?
messages.en: But did you really sleep that long? You're not mistaken because you were sleep-deprived?
So to me, right now is lunchtime.
After just a few days of rest...
My sleep schedule is already flipping.
If I watch dramas, suddenly it's morning.

messages.ko: 해떠있을때 뭐 보면 이것저것 같이하고 막 먹으면서 보고 하니까 집중이 안돼
messages.en: When it's daytime I end up doing other things and eating while watching, so I can't focus.
Looks like we can hang out on live tomorrow.

messages.ko: 그게 그냥 태생적으로 저녁형 인간인 사람이 있대
messages.en: Some people are naturally night owls.
The reason I adapt so well to American time...
In America I'd have such a productive lifestyle.
Maybe you were American in your past life.
Then tonight I'll properly try a past-life experience.
I saw a little boy delivering letters.
A bag bigger than his body.
He was wearing a hat too.
It was probably just someone I saw while scrolling Reels.
So I should get some sleep too.
See you in our past lives.

messages.ko: 넥스트가 벌써 2주년이라니 정말 첫 만남부터 우리 공개될때 두근두근 기다리던 기억 다 너무 생생한데 2년차 넥스트라니! 처음 들어올땐 몇년뒤엔 내가 뭘하고있을지 어떻게 하고있을지 진짜 궁금했는데 그때 써둔 일기에 답을할수 있어서 너무 좋아 2년동안 정말정말 많은 일들이 있었고 많은 추억들이 있어서 앞으로가 더 기대되고 지금 이렇게 과분한 사랑과 성장이 있었다 라고 답해주면 2년전 하연이가 진짜 좋아할것같아 앞으로도 열심히 할거야 지금처럼 나 믿어줘~
messages.en: It's already NXT's 2nd anniversary. From the moment we first met until the day we were revealed, I still vividly remember how excited and nervous I was while waiting. I can't believe we're already in NXT's second year! When I first joined, I was so curious about what I'd be doing and what kind of person I'd become a few years later. I'm so happy that I can finally answer the diary entry I wrote back then. So many things happened over these two years, and we made so many precious memories, so I'm even more excited for what's ahead. If I could tell Hayeon from two years ago that I would receive this much love and grow this much, I think she'd be so happy. I'll keep working hard from now on too, so trust me just like you always have~
There are really so many things I want to say, but...
I believe they've already reached **Y/n**'s heart.
I was thinking about buying a cake with Kim Chaewon...
but we were way too full, so we gave up.
I went on a date with Chaewon today.
We had steak, lasagna, and gnocchi.
Then we had Dubai chewy cookies and ice cream for dessert.
Then we went to a PC bang, played games, and ordered two ramyeon and two drinks.
I taught her how to play Overwatch.
I was totally the unnie today.
So I made her switch to healer and just follow me around.
Why do you hate those? ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I used to play Reaper and Sombra.
But since it's been so long...
I couldn't get back into the rhythm.
Every single one of your picks is an elementary school kid pick.
I used to play when I was younger...
so I'm only just picking it up again after a long time.

messages.ko: 언니가 메르시로 너만 꽂아줄게 언니 믿지
messages.en: Unnie will pocket-heal only you as Mercy. You trust me, right?
Overwatch rule: if you die, eat ramen.
I got disconnected while inhaling my Jin Jjambbong.
I guess I spent too long eating. ㅎ
How is Mercy supposed to carry!!
Earlier, who was our team's healer?
Why were they AFK in the corner?
They said they were eating Jin Jjambbong.
This is basically a hidden ad for Jin Jjambbong now.
It's basically a front ad. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I can eat it very enthusiastically.

messages.ko: 촬영할때 주시는 라면 다 먹을수 있습니다
messages.en: I can finish every cup of ramen you give me during filming.
But when it comes to Jin Jjambbong...
The best way is to microwave the cup ramen before eating it.
Food expert trait: Doesn't add the flavor oil.
That's the opposite of a food expert. The oil is 50% of Jin Jjambbong's flavor.
But why do Dubai chewy cookies taste bad these days?
The ones from Cafe PO-MO are really good...ㅜㅜ
so I just walked in the rain.
Everything was sparkling because it's Christmas.
It felt like a scene from youth.
Chaewon probably had pink broth dripping off her. ㅋ
Mochiz together again after one year.
Our desired vibes are really different.
But after I cut my hair...
Normally when I get a haircut...
"Oh, you cut your hair? When did you do that?"
told me it really suits me.
I've never had this many people say it suits me so well.
It's Christmas Eve~ Somehow my heart feels all warm and fluffy.
Kwak Yeonji is seriously so funny.
but finding out she was completely serious was honestly shocking.
I think I got rid of all the fatigue that had built up at once.
I seriously slept like a bear without waking up.
I woke up for a moment, ordered delivery, then went back to sleep.
I ate the food after it arrived, then went back to sleep again.
Even then, you still managed to order delivery.
Without delivery, I'm basically a corpse.
I slept so deeply that all my spines fell out.
A hedgehog without spines... that's too shocking.
Without spines, aren't you basically just a potato?...
Then I'll steam you and eat you.
If you aren't busy, come join~
Sashimi doesn't make you gain weight, right?
I'm a baby, so I got off work early.
I could have danced to “Let’s take a trip” with high spirits but (t/n: Song by Cho Yong-Pil)'

messages.ko: 오늘 좀 반함 무대위에 올라가서 고백할뻔
messages.en: I seriously fell for you today. I almost went on stage to confess.
I was going to put my glasses on and then dramatically throw them off.
But I looked better with the glasses on.
So I never took them off.
If I only wear them briefly and then take them off...
it feels kind of plain afterward.
I tried it during the first pre-recording though...
I made that decision right away.

messages.ko: 오늘 깨어 인트로도 뭐임 잘생겨서 반했어
messages.en: Even the intro for 'Awake' today... what was that? You were so handsome I fell for you.
I was actually going for a pure, innocent vibe...
If I were to spoil a photo...
I took a selfie with Chaewon today.
It's been such a long time.
Thinking about it, the last time was last year's KBS Song Festival.
we always take one together at the Song Festival.
I've done Haseok so much that...
Maybe I should make content out of it.
is being cheesy and hilariously annoying.
But I ate way too much today.
I don't really want to get any taller anymore.
I think my height is just right.
I'm almost the same height as Joobin.
And I've gotten taller than Shion-unnie.
everyone in NXT is basically acorn-height differences.

messages.ko: 항상 누가 더 크네 마네 하다가
messages.en: We're always arguing over who's taller...
Then we just go, 'You're all acorns anyway!!!' and that's the end of it.
Was there another cover you wanted to see?
For me, I'd like to perform a TWICE song.
I really want to try it.
I'd like to do that one too.
I'd also like to perform BTS's 'Boy In Luv.'
I want to try that too.
Or if we did a unit cover...
I'd love to do a 2NE1 song.
There are so many songs I want to perform.
I'll be able to show you all of them.

I wrapped the noodles in the kimbap and kept eating like a pro.

messages.ko: 걔네가 더 애기들인 거 확실해? ㅋㅋㅋ

so I went to a different Kimbap Heaven.

The owner asked, 'Is this for two people?'

How about we each eat alone at neighboring tables in a BBQ restaurant?
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ Then I guess that could work.

tripleS seriously needs to get tested for shared neurons.
"A hat would match today's outfit really well."
half the members are already wearing hats.

So the salon staff always say...
'You girls really do think exactly alike.'

messages.ko: 갑자기 잡돌이 나온거 생각남 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 면접 나보다 잘보던데 하연이;;;

I was 19 minutes late because I was talking with **Y/n**.
The devil of Growl, Ka. E. De.

messages.ko: 그래 너 내 오른팔에 흑염룡이 잠들어서 다행이지

I cut off all the damaged parts.
'If you really want to remove all the damaged parts...'

messages.ko: 근데 하연이는 얼굴 작고 이목구비 오밀조밀해서 칼단발해도 소화잘할듯 (음식소화아님)

messages.en: Oh right, I heard the 07-line played PUBG today and Jeong Hayeon died immediatelyㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ.

I took out the person who killed Hyerin.

so I should get to sleep early.

Haranghae the most in the whole world~ 😍

I'm always the one giving kisses,
everyone kept liking me so much.

Even when we went shopping together last time,

keeps getting me recommended by their algorithm,

I keep wondering how I can make it even cooler.
Being on stage always excites me.
There really isn't much of this year left.
Time is going by way too fast...

Nothing about me will really change,

we ordered ramyeon, takoyaki, dakgangjeong, and fries,

Is your adult dream still going to a PC bang late at night?
Going to a PC bang by myself,
mastering all the games I want to play,
and eating lots of delicious food.

I promise I won't play Ashe jungle. ㅠㅠㅠㅠ

As long as you call me,

Life itself is one big build-up.
Even the things I said when I was three,
was all leading up to me becoming tripleS.

and just brush it off like that,

and try to say a few more words in Korean.

messages.en: I'll study hard and definitely create that superpower for you...

I'll write it using the story of **Y/n** and me.
I'll write the first line in my dreams.

messages.ko: 근데 왜 아직 안자 내일도 스케줄 있는거 아니야?
messages.en: But why are you still awake? Don't you have schedules tomorrow too?
I'm getting ready for my schedulee.
I saw WAVs at the busking.
So even if I don't sleep...
It feels like I've already slept enough.
What would you like it to be~?
I kind of want to be Snow White today.
But my hair is way too brown to be Snow White.
I heard Snow White likes dyeing her hair too.
No, I'm not close with Snow White... I don't even know who she is.

messages.ko: 너 걔가 먹은 독사과 빼줬어 안빼줬어
messages.en: Were you the one who took the poisoned apple out of her mouth or not?
I'm getting my makeup done right now.
"I'm talking with my lover right now."
When I said I was using Fromm...
She said she knew that would be the case. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 오늘도 예쁠 예정인가보네 너무한다 다른 공주들 어떻게 살을라고...
messages.en: Looks like you're going to be beautiful again today. That's unfair... how are the other princesses supposed to survive?
I have to keep everyone in line.
While having a cup of jasmine tea...
We discussed the future of the princesses.
Jasmine: "Who are you? I never did that."

messages.ko: 뭐야 주빈이 영어이름 자스민이라 주빈이랑 얘기했다는줄 알았는데
messages.en: Wait, I thought you meant Joobin because I thought her English name was Jasmine.
What are you going to eat?!?
But the seasoning was way too spicy.
I'm looking up and down with my eyes.
So I'm replying a little slowly.

messages.ko: 언니 새로나온 닉 주디 챌린지 봣어요 ??
messages.en: Unnie, did you see the new Nick & Judy challenge??
Pay close attention to the one I'm in. ㅎ
The Rudolph Reel was uploaded yesterday, you know.
Are you in the middle of looking upward with your eyes?
At times like that, go experience your past life.
There's a reason we met in this life.
So that's why my heart always ached whenever I looked at you...
Then... could you return the rice I lent you?
When are we filming the tripleS version of EXchange?
How many 'catfish' contestants would there even be?
There are seriously endless content ideas...
There are so many things we could film.
At this rate you'll be filming the Avengers soon.
I like that. Everyone can have their own superpower.
I'd like to go on a variety show where I have to shamelessly act.
Crime Scene would be fun too.
How about being a reenactment actor on Surprise??
Every weekend when I woke up, my dad would have it on.
To me, Surprise means the weekend.
I've even seen a Surprise filming set before.
I saw all the actors too.
I was little, so I don't remember it in detail.

messages.ko: 친구 집에서 놀다가 밖에 간식사러 나가는데
messages.en: I was playing at a friend's house and we went out to buy snacks.
There was a filming crew, so we gathered around and watched.

messages.ko: 그땐 카메라도 현장도 엄청 커보이고 웅장해보이고 그랬는데
messages.en: Back then, the cameras and the whole set looked huge and grand.
It's amazing that this ended up becoming my job.
But as for being an extra in dramas...
I've done it quite a few times.

messages.ko: 뭔가 크게 다르다고 느낀건 없는거 같아
messages.en: So it didn't feel all that different to me.
Anyway, don't go looking for itttt.

messages.ko: 내가 막 잘 보이고 그런건 아니라
messages.en: It's not like I'm clearly visible or anything.
I recently binge-watched that drama again.
You probably wouldn't even know it's me.
But it was honestly such a great experience.

messages.ko: 그런 경험을 해서 내가 아이돌 꿈을 꿀수있었던거 아닐까
messages.en: Maybe experiences like that are what made me dream of becoming an idol.
Since you can't really see me anyway...
I think I filmed it when I was in middle school.
Did you get to meet Park Bo-young?
It's not like I personally did anything...
But maybe because I was there on set...
It almost felt like I helped make it too.
You know what I mean, right?
Now that I think about it...
I've really lived a busy life. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I'd even prepare clothes that matched the filming.
The director picked a few people from the extras.
There was even a scene that started with a one-shot of those people.
And I was one of the people chosen.
It didn't even make it into the final episode.
So I had an experience like that~
But you'll never be able to find me. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I'm either just a blur or someone passing by in the background.
So you've already checked everything yourself.
Then were you able to find yourself?

messages.ko: 나는 내가 어떻게 입었었는지 뭐하고있었는지 아니까 아는데
messages.en: I could, because I know what I was wearing and what I was doing.
Even my mom probably wouldn't recognize me.
It'd be hard to identify me just from my clothes, too~
I was wearing the school uniform the production team gave me.
Ah, I'll just have to find you in my heart instead.
I got off work and washed up.
Did you finally make it back to the dorm...?
I slept in the car, in the waiting room...
I guess being able to sleep anywhere is a blessing.
At least I can sleep well tonight.
We're together on the first day of December too~
Do you have any goals for the rest of the year??
Capture all the beauty of being 19.
Then what about your goals for 2026?
How much prettier can you even get?
So your eyes can't even wander?
I'm really possessive and jealous too.

messages.ko: 귀하게 자란 닐 가지려 하다니 욕심이 많네
messages.en: Trying to have someone who was raised so preciously... you're greedy.
Because you're precious, I want you even more.
Do you know why it's called gaslighting?
Who kept feeling like their house was getting darker.
But the friend replied, "No? I can see fine. You're the strange one."

messages.ko: 이런식으로 가스등을 계속 어둡게 어둡게 만들어서
messages.en: They kept secretly dimming the gas lamps.
Until the person depended entirely on them.

messages.ko: 진짜네 검색해보니까 1938년도에 가스등이라는 연극이 그런 내용이었대
messages.en: You're right. I looked it up and apparently there was a 1938 play called *Gas Light* with that story.
Oh right! It was from a play.
I'm not saying I'd make your surroundings dark.
"Don't you only see me? Isn't there only me for you?"
Please have a crush on me.
I should ask Santa for Jeong Hayeon as my Christmas present.
I've gotten hooked on Dubai chocolate again lately.
But whether it's at the salon or the dorm...
I've already tried all the nearby restaurants.
I always like trying new foods.
And the thing I hate the most is...
The time after I've ordered delivery.
I'm constantly waiting for the delivery rider to arrive.
I can't do anything except stare at Baemin.
And while watching the motorcycle icon...
It's like watching a sports match.
"Hurry hurry!! Cross the light! What are you doing?!"
If they stop somewhere for a long time or go to another house first...
If you can't stand it, do you yell?
"Haaah!! Why are you so late!! I'm hungryyyy!!!"
Once they're near the dorm, I wait at the front door.
I don't even use my phone. I just stare at the door.

messages.ko: 배달 완료 사진 찍힌 적 있는 거 아냐??ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
messages.en: Have you ever accidentally ended up in the delivery completion photo?ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ The back of me carrying it inside in my pajamas.
I wait until the delivery driver leaves before picking it up.
It's kind of awkward if we run into each other.
I drank the gosam tea in one shot, remember?
If you've ever had gosam tea...
I was full of energy until that night.
Whenever I saw people drink it on variety shows...
I'd think, "Is it really that bad? They're just exaggerating for TV."
It felt like my tongue was curling up.
Why did I volunteer to drink it...
Actually, before the PD asked who would do the one-shot...
"Should we just pretend someone drank it and move on?"
So I ended up doing it.
Whenever I go on a variety show...
No, whenever I appear in any kind of content...
I always end up overdoing it...
With unnecessary greed for jokes... and pushing myself too hard.
After filming everything and getting in the car...
"Ha... Why did I push myself so much? I won't be able to watch this..."

messages.ko: 끝나고 나 칭찬 많이 받았어 그래도
messages.en: Still, I got praised a lot after it was over.
The more I embarrass myself, the more everyone seems to enjoy it.
I should always give my all in whatever I do.
Whether it's on stage or in a video...
I only want to show things that are fun and enjoyable to watch from the viewer's perspective.
Because most of the time, I'm a viewer too.
There are things I want to see too, you know.
I just hope that doesn't become a burden for you.
When you're having a hard time, I hope you can see me, forget about it for a while, and smile.
I hope my words can give you strength, even if it's just a little.

messages.ko: 그리고 내가 활동하는게 좋은 이유중 하나는
messages.en: And one of the reasons I love promoting...

messages.ko: 열심히 쓴 편지들이 오래 거치지 않고 바로 받아서 읽을 수 있어서 좋아
messages.en: Is that I can receive and read the heartfelt letters you write without having to wait a long time.

messages.ko: 한글자한글자 내 생각하면서 쓴 이쁜 글씨체들이랑 좋은 얘기들 어떤생각을 하고있는지 어떤 상황인지 막 써놓은거보면
messages.en: When I see your pretty handwriting, every letter written while thinking of me, your stories, your thoughts, and what you're going through...
Because it makes me so happy.
Even if it's not a letter...

messages.ko: 프롬에 적어주는거 올린 사진들 내가 나온 영상들봐주고 그런거 다
messages.en: The things you write on Fromm, the photos you upload, watching the videos I'm in... all of it.
I really, really love the eyes that are looking at me.
Having fans makes me so happy.
I'm not trying to make this into an emotional moment though.ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I just wanted to share what I've been feeling during promotions.
Regardless of whether a lot of people like me or only a few...
Every single one of them is precious to me.

messages.ko: 어떤방식으로 날 좋아해주든 다 너무 행복해졍
messages.en: No matter how you support or love me, it makes me incredibly happy.
Rather than worrying and being anxious about the future...

messages.ko: 행복한 지금을 더 즐기고 더 잘하는게 최선인것같아
messages.en: I think the best thing is to enjoy the happy present more and make the most of it.

messages.ko: 각단이들을 많이 볼수있을때 더 눈에 담고
messages.en: When I get the chance to see all of you more, I want to take in those moments even more.
And whenever I can express how I feel, I want to do it even more.
Thank you so much for this year.
Let's spend even happier days together from now on.
I want to be a good fan for you.

messages.ko: 받은 게 너무 많아서 뭘 줘야 할지 모르겠네
messages.en: I've received so much from you that I don't know what I should give you in return.
I'm genuinely more sincere than you could ever imagine.
I guess I really, really love all of you Hexagons.
It won't happen, but even if one day you grow distant from me...
I'll keep loving you from afar.
I should go to sleep now too.
Let's do our best this December too!
Knowing there are people who come running for me...
I don't know, I got emotional.
I don't think I'm an ENTP.
That's how I end up reacting.
It's not that you *don't* want to be an ENTP, right??????
Are you saying it's self-hatred toward my own kind?
Do ENTPs normally dislike being ENTPs? ㅋㅋㅋ
And I think it suits me.
I don't really know the details.
Just judging from what each letter represents.

messages.ko: 하연이 J 되는날 나 흰머리 가득할듯
messages.en: By the day you become a J, I'll probably be full of gray hair.
I quickly slapped some lotion on my face.
It felt like my face was turning into a desert.
I'm working on a lot of things right now.
It wouldn't be fun if I spoiled it~
If I were to give just a tiny hint...
I've been having really weird dreams.
It feels like my dreams are controlling me.
I wonder if I should tell it.

messages.ko: 제가 전에 영상도 자주보고~ 멤버 뽑는 오디션같은 컨텐츠도 보고~
messages.en: "I used to watch your videos all the time, and even the member audition content!"
Then she asked to take a picture together.
I wondered how we'd take it.
She was on a TV-like monitor.
There was also a woman acting as her body double.
We took hugging photos and piggyback photos.
Then we went into some waiting room.
She was dressed as her 'handsome guy' character.
But she'd only removed the middle part.
"We used to go to the same salon before!!"

messages.ko: 그러다 내 매니저님이 가야한다고 데려가서 차에 탔는데
messages.en: Then my manager said we had to leave, so I got into the car.
We just kept driving around the exact same place.
They told me to get out at the exact same place.
"Then why did we get in the car???"
They kept insisting it was a different place.
And suddenly there was some circus performance.
They told me I was one of the performers.
There was fire and they told me to go inside.
Going into some kind of non-burning oil and coming back out.
While dreaming it I kept thinking...
"This is reality, so why does it feel like a dream?"
As soon as I woke up, I told Shion-unnie.
I told her the whole story.
I've told her so many dreams...
She used to react like that. ㅋㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 근데 꿈을 어떻게 이렇게 자세히 다 기억해? 난 일어나면 금방 다 까먹던데
messages.en: How do you remember your dreams so clearly? I forget mine almost immediately.
If it's an impactful dream, I remember everything.
I even remember dreams from years ago.
A scene that seemed meaningless at the beginning...
Ends up being foreshadowing for something later.
It's like a perfectly written script.

messages.ko: 꿈이 되게 드라마처럼 전개될 때 신기함
messages.en: It's amazing when dreams unfold like a drama.
But these days reality itself feels like a dream.

messages.ko: 막 이것저것하고 막 대기도 하고 샵도 갔다오고 했는데
messages.en: Doing all sorts of things, waiting around, going to the salon...
Yet it feels like I did nothing.
Everything passes by without feeling real.

messages.ko: 촬영을 하는중인건가..? 벌써 다 한건가 지금 뭐하는거지
messages.en: "Are we filming? Are we already done? What am I doing now?"
Nothing happened but everything worked out, so that's Lucky Vicky.
I'll become your very own Rudolph.
Don't step on the snow when it falls.
They say that crunching sound is the snow fairies' bones breaking.
Because I'm actually a snow fairy.
I glued them back together over the summer, but I think they're breaking again.
"Hang up. My person is waiting for me."
That's what I said before hanging up~
Just to say she missed me.
She calls whenever she feels like it.
Can I send Fromm messages anytime too?
If you send me a Fromm...
"Hello to everyone I'm meeting for the first time."
I've been saying it since yesterday.
Wow, you're using an invincibility move.
We're respectable members of society now.
Then what are you, a Martian?
The Nuri rocket launches in 15 minutes.
There's a star in the middle.
Didn't you mistake it for a KTX train?
Does it actually stop if you press the bell?
I'll come back on the day of the first snow.
"I'll go to you like the first snow."
"That my whole world could shine this brightly..."
Instead of a sword, I'd have a flower.
If you pulled the flower out...
Aren't you just the weird village fool?
I've always wanted to film something like that.
Do you know TWICE's '3-Minute Girlfriend' skit?
You'd have to run the microwave 24 times.
I'm confident I'd do it well.
How did we even end up talking about this?
What were we talking about again?
Actually... we've been talking like this the whole time.
It feels like we're dreaming together.
I think I should go dream for real now.
Tomorrow Hayeon is an early-rising bird again.
So I'll eat the worms early.
No wonder there weren't any left for me.
They're the food of the future.
They're the shrimp of the land.
Oh really? I'll have to watch it.
So that's why you're dating Judy?
The makeup took like three hours each time.
She got sprayed with fox repellent last time.
I'm heading to Rabbit Village later. ;;
I'll send this, then go to sleep.
Please invite me to the showcase.
Huh? You're already in the best seat.
That was kind of cliché just now.
But if you're inside my heart...
Your view would be facing the audience.
So you wouldn't actually be able to see me.
Then who am I supposed to look at?
Then look in the mirror every now and then.
I'm addicted to mirrors, so I guess that's fortunate.
It felt like I spent all day with a mirror yesterday.

messages.ko: 하연이는 이번 컴백에 마음 가짐이 어떻게 돼??
messages.en: What's your mindset going into this comeback?
How can I become even prettier?
How can I perform even better?

messages.ko: 어떻게 하면 각단이랑 더 행복할 수 있을까
messages.en: How can I be even happier together with all of you?
Those are the kinds of thoughts I have.
The Zenith stage makes me the most nervous.
I think it'll make me really nervous.
Being nervous because I want to do well feels like a really good thing.
If you hadn't worked hard, you wouldn't even be nervous.

messages.ko: 무대에 못 올라가서 떨리는것보다 무대에서 떨리는게 훨신 좋다고 생각해
messages.en: I'd much rather be nervous while standing on stage than because I couldn't get on stage.
That I'm able to stand on...
I really want to give it my absolute best.
Yesterday I did Reze Hayeon, you know.
That actually wasn't the original concept.
Originally I was just going to tie my hair up.
With a career woman kind of vibe.
"I should go with that then. ㅋ"
So I changed my hair into a bun.
Originally didn't have anything attached to it.
I kept pretending to pull the pin.
I was going around doing that.
But the stylist fixed it back for me.
To cut and attach everything by hand.

messages.ko: 썰 푸는데 신나보이네 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 레제 되게 맘에 들었구나
messages.en: You sound so excited telling this story. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ You really liked the Reze concept.

messages.ko: 너 쌤들한테 사랑 받는 이유 알 것 같기두
messages.en: I think I know why the stylists love you.
Whenever I'm practicing in front of the mirror in the waiting room...

messages.ko: 너 혼자 춤추는데 왜 나한테 말 안했어!!!
messages.en: "Why didn't you tell me you were dancing by yourself!!!"
While pretending to be annoyed with me...
They tell me I'm their favorite.
There are a few that turned out really pretty.

messages.ko: 하연아 우리도 H.O.T.선배님들처럼 20년 30년 되어서도 함께 하자 그때까지도 꼬옥 노래해줘 방금 사진 보고 또 반함..
messages.en: Hayeon, let's also stay together for 20 or 30 years like H.O.T.-sunbaenim. Please keep singing until then. I just fell for you again after seeing that photo...
Watching the stage at Hanteo yesterday...
Seeing them reunite after such a long time...
Performing on a big stage with fans who had waited for them...
And looking so happy on stage...
I really want to become like that too.
The audience also had people of all different ages.

messages.ko: 어릴때 좋아했던 가수를 다 커서 다시보러오는
messages.en: It felt like they had grown up and come back to see the artists they loved when they were younger.

messages.ko: 우린 다시 뭉치지말고 그냥 계속 뭉쳐서 가면 좋겠다
messages.en: Instead of reuniting one day, I hope we can just keep staying together the whole time.

messages.ko: 10년 20년 후에 하연이를 다시 보면 기분이 어떨까
messages.en: I wonder what it'll feel like seeing you again 10 or 20 years from now.
Wouldn't it be nice if it also reminded you of the **Y/n** from 10 years ago?
I think I have to go practice now.
See you on the live later.
If you say you're thinking about me...
The one who manages and supervises.
I finally took out my long padded jacket.
Last time I went to school wearing only a cardigan...
The wind decided to target only me.
The people next to me barely had any wind.
Only I was about to get blown away.
You only realized that now? ㅋ
There's really not much time left until the showcase.
Even though 'Are You Alive?' was this year...
It's my first unit debut promotion!!
I'm not even someone who gets nervous, seriously. ㅋ
So this is basically my first time.
I didn't expect it to be a high-teen concept.
That's why I love it so much.
But it has a different vibe.
"You're exhausted and struggling, but get back up, teenagers!" That was the previous feeling.

messages.ko: 흥! 이미 일어나 있엉 ㅎ 나 최고
messages.en: "Hmph! I'm already up. Hehe, I'm the best."
I got a lot of compliments.
What am I supposed to do with myself? ㅎㅎ
A vlog where I make doenjang jjigae?
Actually, calling it a vlog is...
It didn't get released last time.
If I can, I'll release it this time.
It'll probably be uploaded as a Short.
I filmed it so everyone could cook along.
I was surprised by how tasty it was. ㅋ
Did Lynn, the biggest doenjang jjigae fan, try it?
She ate it when we went on the countryside trip.
So it wasn't entirely my own skill.
Then what do you normally use? Do you make the doenjang yourself?
Oh, like grinding soybeans and everything?

messages.ko: 내가 다 건조 시켜서 잘 담그고
messages.en: I dry and ferment everything myself.
I even make the pot myself.
It'll take ten years just to make the stew.
I've been making it since the day I was born.
I'll just go decide what to order.
Actually, I'm just going to eat eggs.
I'll turn it on in about ten minutes.
Let me get everything ready first~
Take a rest while you wait.
Go on a date with this while you wait.
I finished my schedule and now I'm at school~~~~
I just got caught by the teacher for using my phone.
Can I look forward to a school uniform selfie...?
Sadly, I don't wear my school uniform when I go to school...
That's right, I'm a third-year high school student~~
Right, the teaser came out yesterday.
You're so handsome that my heart hurts...
I do look a bit handsome today.
You were even riding on top of the car.
It looked so fun that I wanted to be in tripleS too.
The extras were following behind us.
They were following us while shouting that.
There were a lot of foreigners too.
I think the music video is going to look really pretty.
Well, I filmed it after all... so I guess it will.
No, I don't mean I filmed it...
Right, I mean I was the one being filmed.
It's lunchtime. What did you eat? School lunch?
I think I need to hurry back to the dorm first.
I've already been bitten three times.
Why do they keep biting me?
I even got bitten on the sole of my foot.
It's such an awkward place to scratch.
I'm going to see the teacher.
Thankfully, I don't really feel like scratching it anymore.
Should I go live once I get back to the dorm?
You said you couldn't sleep, so just sleep...
First-ever reveal of my sleep talking! Something like that.
I don't snore when I sleep.
But I'm really good at making snoring sounds.
I'm catching up on overdue homework right now...
It feels strange holding a pen again after such a long time.
If I can go live once I get back to the dorm, I will.

messages.ko: 무빙 옵적 하연이가 즉석에서 아이디어 낸거야?
messages.en: Did you come up with the Moving Objekt idea on the spot?
Originally it was supposed to be a little less intense and just cute.
But it turned into an intense dumpling.
I'm thinking of making the next Objekt completely cool.
But I'm still way too cute!!!!!
Today I'm going for a more mature vibe.

My very own Dubai chewy cookie...

messages.ko: 벌써 알피투어가 끝이 났다니이 이제 알피조합과 무대를 못본다는 생각에 슬프기도하고 무대중간에 웨이브들이 전하는 너무 감동적인 영상을 봐서 그런가 후유증이 쎈 무대였어 ㅠㅠ 많은 도시 다니면서 이 셋리스트와 멤버조합 그리고 항상 같이 다니시던 직원분들 열정적이고 귀여운 웨이브들까지 그 모든 공기를 다 담고싶었어 내 기억속엔 선명하게 남겠지만 더이상 느끼지 못할거라는 생각에 너무 아쉽고 더 즐길걸 잘할걸 싶다 ㅠㅠ 빠른시일 내에 투어가 있을지도 모르지만(나도 모름) 그땐 내가 가지 않을수도 있으니까 오늘 마지막 공연에서 뭔가 애틋했어 ㅋㅋㅋ 그래도 무사히 투어를 끝냈으니까 한편으론 후련하기도 하다! 과거의 내가 일기에 적어놓은 내용중에 넌 곧 투어를 갈텐데 잘 하고있니 실력은 더 늘었니 이런 내용이 있는데 이제 답 해줄 수 있을것같아ㅏ
messages.en: I can't believe the Alphie tour has already come to an end. Thinking that I won't get to see this Alphie lineup and stage anymore makes me sad, and maybe because I watched the incredibly touching video that WAVs prepared during the performance, this stage left such a strong aftereffect on me. ㅠㅠ As we traveled through so many cities, with this setlist, this member lineup, the staff who were always with us, and even the passionate and adorable WAVs, I wanted to hold onto every bit of that atmosphere. It'll stay vivid in my memories, but knowing I won't be able to experience it anymore makes me regret not enjoying it even more and not doing even better. ㅠㅠ There might be another tour soon (I don't know either), but I might not even be part of it, so today's final performance felt especially sentimental. ㅋㅋㅋ Still, since we finished the tour safely, I also feel relieved. In my old diary, I once wrote, 'You'll be going on tour soon. Are you doing well? Have your skills improved?' I think I can finally answer that now.
I really think being on stage is something wonderful.

messages.ko: 콘서트할때마다 마지막쯤엔 공연소감을 말하는데 그앞에선 깊은 내 진심을 다 말하기엔 너무 길어서 항상 끝나고 프롬으로 얘기하는것같은데 직접 말 못해줘서 항상 아쉽고 더 길게 말할걸 더 표현할걸 후회하기도 해 이번 서울콘서트에선 나의 자잘한 실수도 많았고 개인적으로 완벽하지 못한 무대들이였다고 생각해.. 몸 컨디션도 제대로 못챙겼고 그런 부분에서 정말 미안해ㅜㅜ 콘서트 보러와서 이런모습 보고싶었던건 아닐텐데 너무 속상하고 더 잘할수 있었는데 하는 나에게 서운함도 있어 근데 콘서트는 무대에 서는 아티스트나 응원해주러온 팬분들이나 즐겁고 행복하자고 하는거니까 앞으로 더 나아진 모습을 약속하고!! 지금은 행복만 남겨둘게 웨이브앞에선 항상 잘하고 멋지고 이쁜 모습만 보여주고싶은 욕심이 너무커서 오히려 속상함도 큰것같아 하지만 그래서 내가 성장할수 있는것같다고 느꼈어! 이제 활동도 있고 이것저것 또 만날수 있는 날들이 엄청 많을텐데 지금처럼 옆에서 응원해주면 난 뭐든 할수있을것같아☺️ 나한텐 팬 한명한명이 다 소중하고 많이 사랑해 나를 좋아하는게 물론 당연하지 않은것도 알고 조건없이 날 사랑해주는 사람들한테 정말 잘하고싶어!! 오늘 와준 웨이브 너무너무 고맙고 못온 웨이브도 응원해줘서 고마워 ㅎㅎ 오래 많이 행복하게 보자! 나의 힘이 되어줘서 고마워 나도 항상 힘이 되어줄게ㅔ😘 오글거려도 참아 내 진심이니까~
messages.en: Every time we have a concert, I share my thoughts near the end, but saying all of my true feelings there would take too long, so I always end up talking about them on Fromm afterwards. I'm always disappointed that I can't say everything directly, and I often regret not expressing myself more. At this Seoul concert, I made quite a few small mistakes, and personally I don't think my performances were perfect. I also didn't take good care of my physical condition, and I'm really sorry about that. ㅜㅜ You probably didn't come to see this kind of 모습 from me, and I feel so upset because I know I could have done better. But concerts are meant to be a happy and enjoyable time for both the artists on stage and the fans who come to cheer us on, so I promise I'll continue to improve. For now, I'll leave behind only the happy memories. My desire to always show WAVs only my best, coolest, and prettiest side is so strong that I think that's why I get even more disappointed. But because of that, I also feel like I can continue to grow. We have promotions coming up, and there will be so many more opportunities for us to meet. If you continue cheering me on by my side like you do now, I feel like I can do anything. ☺️ Every single fan is precious to me, and I love you all so much. I know that liking me isn't something I should ever take for granted, and I truly want to do my best for the people who love me unconditionally. Thank you so, so much to the WAVs who came today, and thank you to the WAVs who couldn't come but still supported me. ㅎㅎ Let's stay together happily for a very, very long time! Thank you for becoming my strength. I'll always become your strength too. 😘 Even if it's cheesy, please endure it, because these are my sincere feelings~

그거 꽤 흔한 증상이야 - 감기에 걸린 상태에서 비행기를 타면, 비행 중 압력 변화 때문에 귀 속 이관 (귀와 코를 연결하는 통로)이 막혀서 * '이충만감' * 이나 귀 먹먹함, 심하면 일시적인 청력 저하가 생길 수 있어. ✈️👂
👉도움이 되는 방법들:
• 하품/꿀꺽 삼키기: 침을 삼키거나 하품을 일부러 해보면 이관이 열릴 수 있어.

messages.en:
That's actually a pretty common symptom. If you fly while you have a cold, changes in cabin pressure can block your Eustachian tube (the passage connecting your ear and nose), causing *ear fullness* or a blocked-ear feeling, and in more severe cases, even temporary hearing loss. ✈️👂

👉 Things that may help:
• Yawn / Swallow: Try swallowing or forcing a yawn to help open your Eustachian tube.
• Pinch your nose and gently blow (Valsalva maneuver): Close your mouth, pinch your nose, and blow very gently as if trying to exhale through your nose. You may feel your ear 'pop' open. Don't blow too hard.
• Warm compress: Applying a warm towel or compress around your ear can improve blood circulation and help relieve the discomfort.
• Stay hydrated: Keeping your mucous membranes moist can help speed up recovery.
• Nasal decongestant spray: After checking with a doctor or pharmacist, using a suitable decongestant spray may help.

⚠️ Warning signs to watch for:
• Ear pain becomes severe.
• Only one ear continues to feel blocked.
• Ringing in the ear (tinnitus) or dizziness develops.
• No improvement after 2–3 days.

If any of these happen, it's a good idea to visit an ENT specialist.

👉 For now, the best things you can try are yawning, swallowing, and the Valsalva maneuver.

messages.en: I'm here!! We wrapped up the Seoul concert really well, and now I'm about to head off for our Japan concerts! This time, the stages were on a much bigger scale than what we usually perform on, so even while preparing, just imagining myself standing on those stages kept making me smile. It was so amazing and surreal knowing that everyone filling such a huge venue was our WAVEs. Like I said during my ending ment, I really think we're growing together. As much as WAVE gives us strength, we try our best to give it back, helping each other grow. Everyone I saw from the stage looked so, so beautiful, and it made me want to give you everything I possibly can. I really gave it my all, but I'm still a little disappointed. Since the preparation period was short, I couldn't show you everything as perfectly as I'd imagined. But it was such a happy time that I don't want to dwell on it. Instead, I'll focus on the stages I'll show you from now on. Thank you, always.🩷

It feels like it was only yesterday,
