messages.en: Today is NXT's birthday~~~ Thank you so much for celebrating it with me. Around this time last year, when I saw myself being revealed, I think I was half excited and half scared, my heart was racing. Me... debuting!! I wondered if this was a dream or reality, and I might have even felt strangely numb about it ㅎㅎ. When I first met the fans and when I first started using Fromm, I was so awkward and clumsy, but WAV actually helped me relax. Thank you for loving the Hayeon from a year ago, who still had so many shortcomings, and thank you for loving the me of today, who's grown even if only a little. I'm so happy that our bond has become deeper over the past year. I might not be expressing my feelings very well because I'm just writing whatever comes to mind, but I think you know how I feel~~😘 Thank you for making me who I am today. And Christmas is coming soon, right? You didn't cry too much this year, did you? That's how you get presents. If you cried a lot this year, I hope there won't be any more tears. I'll allow tears of happiness. Bad Santa is strict with people who cry, but Good Santa doesn't worry about things like that.
I guess I'm a good Santa.

messages.ko: 1년전 하연이는 나를 좋아해주는 이렇게 많은 사람들이 생길거라곤 상상도 못했겠지만 너의 주변엔 이렇게 좋은사람들이 많이 생겼다는걸 1년전 하연이한테 말해주고싶넹
messages.en: The Hayeon from a year ago could never have imagined that so many people would come to love me, but I'd love to tell the Hayeon from a year ago that so many wonderful people would come into your life.
Let's make this one the 1st anniversary gift.
To celebrate how much I've grown.
Let's have a happy end of the year.

notices.text: Later that day — Starting at 9:35 PM

messages.en: I ate malatang with Yubin unnie.
At the MMA, I focused on my contact lenses.
Today, I tried something new with my hair.

messages.ko: 오늘 아쉬움도 많고 행복함도 많았던 무대같아
messages.en: I think today's stage was one with both a lot of regrets and a lot of happiness.
The fact that tripleS gets to stand on an end-of-year stage is really...
Like a dream. Thank you so much. ㅜㅠ
Among all the lightsticks in the audience,
just thinking that Wav would be there
takes a lot of effort and uses up that much energy,
but seeing that I'm still doing okay,
I guess Y/n's support reached me.
I also had my first collaboration stage.
When we welcome the New Year,

messages.ko: 그리거 오늘 머리 깐이유를 물어본 사람이 많은데
messages.en: Also, a lot of people asked why I showed my forehead today.

messages.ko: 뭔가 연말느낌 나면서 새로운 느낌을 주고싶어서
messages.en: I wanted to give off an end-of-year vibe while trying something new.
I feel like I've already tried every hairstyle with bangs...
I'll send them when I have timeee.

messages.ko: 하연이 근데 케플러 채현님이랑 연습 하다가 친해진거야?? 초련 무대 하다가 서로 보고 웃던데 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
messages.en: Hayeon, did you become close with Kep1er's Chaehyun while practicing?? I saw you two looking at each other and smiling during the performanceㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I should get ready and head to bed too.
Starting tomorrow, I'm going on a diet for the tour.
I finally finished dieting for the KBS Song Festival.
The reason there are so many recommendations for chicken feet and gopchang...
is because you've figured out my taste, right?

messages.ko: 오늘 나온 월드투어 티저? 되게 추워보이네
messages.en: The world tour teaser that came out today? It looks really cold.
I seriously had to hold my breath while filming that.
The wind stung because it was so cold.
and then realized it was an outdoor shoot.
There's less than three weeks lefttt.
I filmed a lot of Reels.
while I was filming with Kim Soomin,
I look like a completely different person?

messages.ko: 야 너 평소에도 까고다니면 안돼? 아니 진짜 너무이뻐
messages.en: "Hey, why don't you wear your forehead exposed more often? Seriously, you're so pretty."
"You showed your forehead today? Why did you do that...?"
so everyone was split into two groups.

messages.ko: 샵쌤들은 모두가 아니 하연이 앞머리 없애고 다녀!!! 이러시거
messages.en: All the stylists were like, "No, Hayeon! Just get rid of your bangs and keep it like that!!!"
So I told Dahyun unnie, who's on Team Forehead,
"Oh... that's a way to do it."
I'll just show my forehead once in a while.
If having my forehead exposed had been my normal look,
then having bangs would've probably been the controversial one, right?

messages.ko: 하연이 두고 수민이 채원이 질투하는구나 인기는 피곤해
messages.en: Soomin and Chaewon are getting jealous over Hayeon. Being popular must be exhausting.
Why are there so many people who like me? ㅎㅎ😎

messages.ko: 너가 여기저기 매력을 흘리고 다녀서 그래
messages.en: Because you're leaving your charm everywhere you go.
The problem is that so many people pick it up.ㅎ
I heard Chaehyun is going to become close to you after falling for your charm too.

messages.ko: 하연이가 어제 한 말 보시고 귀엽대ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
messages.en: They said you were cute after seeing what you said yesterdayㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Ah, that makes my heart flutter?
Being called cute by a pretty girl...

messages.ko: 이름에 채 들어간 사람들을 좋아하네 내가
messages.en: I guess I like people whose names have 'Chae' in them.
I completely forgot because I was on Fromm.
I'm going to eat it all by myself.

messages.ko: 이제 누가 냄새맡고 한입만 시전하러 올듯
messages.en: Now someone's probably going to smell it and come over asking for 'just one bite.'
Okay, I'm really going to order now.
I'll come back again next time.

notices.text: Hayeon changed her Fromm profile picture.

messages.en: Does it feel like you're talking to a new girl?
Seeking something new isn't a good thing!!
What did you set as your wallpaper?
It doesn't even show my face.
And you'll think about me every day.
If someone asks who it is.
??: Someone who lives in a corner of my heart…
??: Someone who wishes for my happiness for life…🥀
I love Hayeon so much I'm crying... I can prove it.
Please send a photo where the tear marks are clearly visible.
I heard Hexagons' tears even come out in hexagons.
You have to look with a microscope.

messages.ko: 언니 누구냐고 물어보면 여자친구라고 대답해도 돼??
messages.en: If someone asks who you are, can I say you're my girlfriend??

messages.ko: 하연아 보고싶어 붕어빵 보는데 너 생각나서 슈붕 먹었어
messages.en: Hayeon, I missed you. I saw bungeoppang and thought of you, so I ate custard-filled bungeoppang.
A little while ago when it snowed.
I ate a hot custard bungeoppang.
I did well on the test.
Well... I only took it well.
I don't know if I actually got the answers right ㅎ.
Finishing the exam early and sleeping.
You know that's the best sleep ever, right?
Today I went with no makeup and my face was all puffy.
"You look like you slept for 15 hours."
Wearing makeup during exam period is a luxury.
I'm the only one not there!!
Going to be Lilaz by myself.
Could you confidently film a vlog like Soomin?
The kids at my school are all such extreme extroverts.
If I put the camera down, they'd probably start filming themselves.
You're a pretty big extrovert too, Hayeon.
I used to crawl around the hallway on all fours.
But now that I'm in tripleS.
I feel like I shouldn't do that anymore.
My friends and I each picked a superpower.
What was yours? The answer is teleportation.
I'd dash around like a praying mantis.
Then fire off a palm blast.
If I used my palm blast, my friend had to pretend to get blown away.
I think my friend used Panda Fist.
I had to pretend to get hit.

messages.ko: 사마귀장풍이 더 쌔 팬더권법이 더 쌔
messages.en: Which is stronger, Praying Mantis Palm Blast or Panda Fist?
That depends on who has the stronger fighting spirit.
Whoever launches it more fiercely ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㄹㄹ.
You didn't break character in the middle, right?
When the class bell rang, that meant one round was over.
We seriously played until we were sweating.
Didn't the teachers... look at you weirdly?
Some students did look at us strangely.
Even people you weren't close with..?
There were only two classes in each department, so everyone was close enough to do that..ㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
The reason I can't do it now is...
if I'm over there using Praying Mantis Palm Blasts and stuff...
they'd probably lose interest in me...
"??: Hey, hey! tripleS Hayeon unnie is here!! ...Wait, why is she shooting palm blasts...?"
Our school uniform is pretty too...
Only 12 days left of high school sophomore Hayeon in a school uniform;;;
who I should wear it with.
I'll try to do it on the next live.
Were you just trying to create an opportunity??
Why are you crushing my spirit!!!!!!!!!
What's gotten into you these days.
This is the funniest thing anyone's said ㅋㄹㅎㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋ
I can practically hear it in my head.
Hayeon's comedy form has fallen off.
We're just trying to make Jeong Hayeon into an even more perfect all-rounder.
I'm slowly starting to get sleepy.
I have to wake up early tomorrow too.
I need to get up early.
Hi! I don't think I can come in the evening, so I'm here now.
The weather is so nice that I started to miss you.
Today is so cool and clear.
There's also the Mokpo event tomorrow.
It's been a while since I had a live event, so I'm excited.
Of course, I'm planning to look pretty tomorrow too~
I haven't decided on my hairstyle yet.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ It might depend on the outfit.
I'll try to go with something you'll probably like the most.
I'm in the mood to listen to some music.
If you recommend something, I'll listen to it.
From those, the one I like the most...
I might mention it on the radio.
If it matches my taste, that is.
Leave it for me, and I'll listen to itㅎㅎ
I'll listen to all the songs!!
Think about Hayeon a lot today too~
I hope only good things happen to you.

messages.ko: 하잉! 요즘 너무너무 감사하게도 바쁜 하루하루를 보내는중이야 연습도있고! 여러가지로 열심히 하고있어!! 이번에 멜뮤시상식 나가는거 들었지!! 영광스럽게도 출연하게되었는데 그 누구보다 열심히 준비할테니까 기대해주고 친친라디오도 나가게 됐거등~~ 앞으로 기대해줄거 응원해줄거 많으니까 마음의 준비하라고 보내는 오랜만의 장문이야 ㅎ내일도 바쁘고 알찬하루를 보낼예정이지만 ..!
messages.en: Hii! I'm so grateful to be so busy these days, I've got practice and all sorts of things! I'm working really hard in many ways!! You heard that I'll be going to the Melon Music Awards this time!! I'm honored to be appearing, so I'll prepare harder than anyone else, please look forward to it. I'm also going to be on ChinChin Radio~~ There are so many things to look forward to and cheer for in the future, so to get you ready, this is a long message I'm sending after a long timeㅎ Tomorrow too, I'm planning to have another busy, fulfilling day..!
In the middle of all this, I miss you 🥹
I want to talk to you.
But I might not wake up on time tomorrow.
So I'll stop here and try to sleep…

messages.ko: 하연이가 이번에 롤렉스 커버 댄스에 들어갔는데 기대되나요?
messages.en: Hayeon, you're in the Rolex cover dance this time. Are you excited for it?
Oh, that's right! I saw it!!

messages.ko: 너랑 어울릴 것 같아서 너무 기대돼
messages.en: I'm really looking forward to it because I think it'll suit you.
We decided to make it look really cool.
Since we're doing it, we've got to leave behind an awesome video.
Is there anyone's part that you'd like to do??
Hmm, who do you think I'll end up doing?
I feel like I'll probably end up doing Nakyoung unnie's or Hyerin's part.
I'm curious which part I'll end up getting.
I'm looking forward to it too.
No matter what part I get, I'll make it look cool.
Should I show my forehead again?

messages.ko: 나는 하연이가 반묶음 했을때 그렇게 공주같드라
messages.en: I think you look just like a princess when you wear your hair in a half-up style.
Then how about half-up with half my bangs up?
Right, let's go with the half-and-half chicken concept.

messages.ko: 메이크업도 얼굴 왼쪽은 청순 오른쪽은 시크컨셉으로하자
messages.en: Let's make the makeup half innocent on the left side and half chic on the right side too.
Oh, hearing that just reminded me of something.
Even in my dream, I was thinking about what hairstyle I should do.

messages.ko: 한쪽은 빠글빠글하고 한쪽은 아예 쭉 피신거야
messages.en: One side of my hair was super curly, while the other side was completely straight.

messages.ko: 음…! 조아요! 이제 메이크업 받으러 갈게요!
messages.en: "Hmm...! I like it! I'll go get my makeup done now!"
Then I went to the makeup room.
"Since your hair is unbalanced, let's make the makeup unbalanced too."

messages.ko: 하고 한쪽은 완전 쎄고 무섭고 다크한데
messages.en: So one side became super fierce, scary, and dark,
while the other side was completely hot pink.
I stared at myself in the mirror, feeling completely conflicted.
Then I ended up going to the broadcast.
I had to walk the red carpet.
I burst into tears right there.

messages.ko: 근데 그러고 레드카펫에 이상하게 하고와놓고 펑펑 운 아이돌로 유명해져서
messages.en: Then I became famous as the idol who showed up looking weird on the red carpet and cried her eyes out.
After that, I think I just kept going around like that.
When I woke up, it left such a strong impression on me.
Y/n, do you have a dream that left a strong impression on you?

messages.ko: 난 초등학교때 꿨던 우리동네에 좀비나온꿈은 아직도 기억나 내용 모두다
messages.en: I still remember a dream I had in elementary school where zombies appeared in my neighborhood. I remember every detail.
If I ever appear in your dream...
it'll definitely be a dream you'll never forget.

messages.ko: 꿈보다 더 꿈같은 현실을 보내자 우리❤️데헷
messages.en: Let's live a reality that's even more dreamlike than a dream. ❤️ Dehet.
Oh, did I mention this before?
I've always been interested in it,
but lately I've gotten even more into studying history.
I've been studying it really hard.
About times we never lived in...

messages.ko: 지금 이 땅에서 무슨일이 일어났었는지 궁금하지않아?
messages.en: Aren't you curious about what happened on this land back then?
I'm not quite that far yet. ^^^
I'm also really curious about the time when my mom and dad were young.
But... you came in last in the Badge Wars general knowledge quiz?
That was an advanced strategy, you know.

messages.ko: 내가 뱃지를 많이 가져서 분량을 얻는건 아주 힘들겠군
messages.en: I figured it'd be really hard to get screen time just by collecting lots of badges.
So I quickly decided on a different concept.

messages.ko: 추석 자컨 게임 꼴찌는 어떻게 된건데 그럼
messages.en: Then what about coming in last in the Chuseok self-content games?
Seriously, what is he even doing?
I have a song that I want to recommend.
I've been listening to it a lot these days.

messages.ko: 가사가 딱 내가 하고 싶은 말이야
messages.en: and the lyrics are exactly what I want to say.

messages.ko: 이거 들으면 하연이도 내 옆에 있어주는 거야?
messages.en: If I listen to it, will Hayeon be by my side too?
The song is so good, right?
And even though this is out of the blue...
I was on my way to school in the morning.
I was wondering what song I should listen to,

messages.ko: 우리 노래를 다 듣게 된 거야
messages.en: so I ended up listening to all of our songs.
As soon as that part came on...
Hayeon, you've been really emotional lately.
so I wanted to tell you.
You're not having a hard time or anything, right~~??
I took the subway that day!
It reminded me of the Hayeon from back then.
but I realized I've changed so much.

messages.ko: 내 목소리가 들어간 일본 데뷔곡도 듣고
messages.en: I even listened to our Japanese debut song with my voice in it.
I'd wake up early in the morning, take the subway,
and head to the practice room.
It's cute how you answer so diligently on Fromm.

messages.ko: 무대에서 정하연 응원 엄청 열심히 해주는 것도 귀엽고
messages.en: It's cute how you cheer for Jeong Hayeon so enthusiastically when she is on stage.
It's cute how you brag about liking me.

messages.ko: 자주 못 봐서 보고 싶다고 하는 것도 귀엽고
messages.en: It's cute when you say you miss me because you don't see me often.
How can I tell you everything?

messages.ko: 육각단이 좋은 이유는 100가지도 말할 수 있을 것 같아
messages.en: I think I can list 100 reasons why the Hexagons are so great.
I'm the type who has to say it out loud.
It might be a little cheesy,
but I have to express it.
That's what makes me feel relieved.
No, I really do think that way.
I'll just accept being an F.
What? I guess I'm actually really cute then.
You're making me not want to admit it.
I like the Hexagons too, so let's fangirl together. 🤙

messages.ko: 하연이가 준 카톡 사진으로 바꿨더니 선배가 누구냐고 연락 왔어
messages.en: I changed my KakaoTalk profile to the picture you gave me, and my senior messaged asking who it was.

messages.ko: 왠지 또 다른 내가 된 기분이네
messages.en: I feel like I've become another version of myself.
That's totally Lucky Luna, isn't it??
I'm really pushing the Lucky Luna concept.

messages.ko: 오늘 밤도 육각단이랑 토탈 럭키 루나
messages.en: Tonight too, it's Total Lucky Luna with the Hexagons.
Luna feels like a princess. Are you a princess??

messages.ko: 수능까지 70일 남았는데 하연이식 가정법 분석 좀 해주세요……
messages.en: There are 70 days left until the CSAT. Please give me a Hayeon-style way of looking at it...

messages.ko: 내 인생에서 70일 동안 열심히 공부할 기회가 있는 거잖아?? 토탈 럭키 루나~
messages.en: It means I have a chance to study hard for 70 days in my life, right?? Total Lucky Luna~
Apparently Luna means the goddess of the moon!

messages.ko: 어릴 때 아무 생각 없이 내가 고른 이름인데
messages.en: I picked that name without thinking when I was little,
The moon is beautiful, isn't it?
Luna mode is different from Haseok mode.
Luna is the flower-garden positivity queen.
Hayeon is the perfect hexagonal idol.

messages.ko: 육각형은 성격이 여섯 개라서 그래. 나머지 세 개도 궁금해
messages.en: Since you're a hexagon, you should have six personalities. I'm curious about the other three.
It'd be fun if you used a different personality for every stage...
Oh, that's actually a good idea.
It'd feel like stanning six different idols.
Let's come up with the other three personalities too.
How about a gangster? Oh... you already have that one.
Thank you so much for becoming S19.
Whenever I hear something like that,
Let's do our best today too.

messages.ko: Y/n 나 어떤 상황이든 열심히 할게!
messages.en: Y/n, I'll work hard no matter what situation I'm in!
You asked me a lot of questions too.
If things work out, that's great.

messages.ko: 안 되면 어쩔 수 없는 거고
messages.en: If they don't, then it can't be helped.
I think as long as I do my best, everything will be okay.
And even if things don't go well,
many more times in the future,
so don't be too disappointed or worried~
As long as you're here, Y/n, everything will be okay.
Let's do our best today too!
I know about all the effort you put in for me.
I'm going to work out and then sleep..
I feel like I was still in Hong Kong.
Since I'm here alone at the dorm,
and I'm alone in the living room.
I've got food in front of me,
This is what real love is.
I thought about wanting to come there with you.

messages.ko: 멀리서 보면 도시 위에 구름이 있는데
messages.en: From far away, there were clouds above the city,
I also tried really hard to film a vlog...
I don't know if I filmed it well though.
I think this will be the vlog thumbnail.
I ate hot pot that day,
and I also had bread from the convenience store.

messages.ko: 현지 음식은 하연이 입맛에 잘 맞았어?
messages.en: Did the local food suit your taste?

messages.ko: 근데 홍콩이 한국이랑 비슷한 게 많아서
messages.en: Hong Kong has a lot of things that are similar to Korea,
so I think the food suits my taste too!

messages.ko: 홍콩 편의점이랑 일본 편의점은 뭐가 다른지 궁금해
messages.en: I'm curious about the difference between convenience stores in Hong Kong and Japan.

messages.ko: 크게 다른 건 없는 것 같아
messages.en: I don't think they're that different.
there's dim sum and things like that.

messages.ko: 음 그런 게 다른 것 같아
messages.en: I think that's the biggest difference.
I've been going to a lot of events lately,
and there'll be even more in the future.

messages.ko: 새로운 노래랑 내가 추는 파트를 보는 것도 좋을 것 같아
messages.en: I think it'll be fun for you to see the new songs and the parts I dance.
"Y/n is going to like this." ㅋ
I think things like that too.
Like, "I'm kind of cool," you know?
And while talking with the members,

messages.ko: 내가 엄청 운 좋은 하연이라는 이야기가 나왔어
messages.en: we ended up talking about how I'm a really lucky Hayeon.
Usually when stage positions or parts are decided,
there are times when you end up at the back or the end.
even if I'm at the end,

messages.ko: 다들 나를 보고 있는 것 같고
messages.en: I feel like everyone is still looking at me.

messages.ko: 끝에 있어도 내 자리가 제일 좋은 자리인 것 같아
messages.en: Even if I'm at the end, I feel like it's the best spot.

messages.ko: 끝에 앉아 있는 사람들한테 내 모습을 보여줄 수 있고
messages.en: I can show myself to the people sitting at the end.

messages.ko: 더 잘 보이려고 크게 춤춰서 눈에 띄고
messages.en: I can dance bigger to stand out and be seen better.
Now that I think about it,
I think it's actually a good mindset.
I'll keep walking my own path!!
If I keep walking my own path,

messages.ko: Y/n도 따라와 줄 사람이 있을 거라고 생각해
messages.en: I think you'll naturally follow me too, Y/n.

messages.ko: 물론 해야 할 일, 잘해야 할 일은 열심히 하고
messages.en: Of course, I'll work hard on everything I need to do and everything I should do well.
knows what I like, right? ㅋ
I'm going to end up with turtle neck.
I'd better relax them a little.
The fact that someone like Y/n
exists... thank you for letting me know that.
It might sound cheesy, but bear with me.
I should say the things I want to say. ❤️

messages.ko: 내가 너만의 달이 되어줄게. 너는 내 해가 되어줄래?.... 🥀🥀
messages.en: I'll be your moon. Will you be my sun?.... 🥀🥀
So... who's going to present now..?
Did I get drunk through my eyes? 훟ㅎ
I want to see a girl born in 2007 at this hour...

messages.ko: 오늘은 육회랑 연어를 이긴 기념비적인 날이야
messages.en: Today is a historic day—the day you beat the yukhoe and salmon.

messages.ko: 알아. 지금 눈앞에 있는데 안 먹고 있는 거잖아
messages.en: I know. It's right in front of me, and I'm still not eating it.
I'll eat quickly and go to bed early..
You know I love you, right?
I'm watching Jeong Hayeon's Secret Base.
What? When did it get uploaded?
I don't like it because I filmed it while I was tired.

messages.ko: 아니 영상내내 왼쪽얼굴 사수하는거 웃김 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
messages.en: It's funny how you spent the whole video protecting your left side. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Even if I die, I'm protecting my left side.
but I forgot what I need to pack,
I'm so, so, so, so excited for Hong Kong. ❤️❤️❤️
It's going to be so much fun.
Just like I did in Japan,
I left one side of my suitcase completely empty.
I'm planning to buy a ton of stuff there.
Ah, what was I about to do again?
I worked hard filming one in Japan too.
I bought a bunch of pretty clothes too.
I'm going to wear them there.

messages.ko: 필요한거 꾹참고 참다가 오늘 다 사버렸어
messages.en: I'd been holding back on buying what I needed, but today I finally bought everything.
The contact lenses in my profile picture...
Everyone's been really curious about them. ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
They're toric lenses that stay fixed in place.
If you search for them, they'll probably come right up~
Thanks to you, I have blue eyes now.
I wonder if I'll get a contact lens advertisement~

messages.ko: 난 진짜 맛있는음식 광고 같은거 찍어서
messages.en: I'd really love to film an advertisement for delicious food...
to show you every side of me.
Although... I think I've already shown you quite a lot...
Then can I show you everything about me too?
So from now on I can burp and stuff, right?
Why would you do that? ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
May I leave? I think it smells in here.
Hayeon doesn't do things like that.
It's actually really hard for me to eat. ㅠㅠ

messages.ko: 그런 거 치곤 너무 잘 먹던데
messages.en: You say that, but you eat way too well for that.

messages.ko: 나사실 아주 작지만 강력한 날개도 있어서
messages.en: Actually, I have very tiny but powerful wings too.
I'm always nervous that I might suddenly fly away.
Like, 'Uh-oh, I'm about to take off.'
I still can't control them because I'm still just a baby.
Once I become an adult, I'll be able to control them.
Right now, I'm chewing on the squid legs Seoah bought.
I'm so happy because I'm snacking on all the treats Seoah bought.

messages.ko: 찐 친언니 같아서 더 킹받네 ㅋㅋ
messages.en: You really act like a real older sister, which somehow makes it even funnier. ㅋㅋ
I've gotten really close to Seoah.
She honestly feels like my real little sister now.

messages.ko: 서아한테 요즘 유행하는게 뭔지 잘 알아봐봐 이제 언니들은 그런거 따라가기 힘글어
messages.en: Ask Seoah what's trending these days. It's hard for the older sisters to keep up with that stuff now.
I'll learn it first and teach you.

messages.ko: 내생일 축하해준 모든웨이브들 너무너무 고맙고 감동이였어 생일 하루를 완벽하게 행복하개 만들어줘서 너무너무 기뻤어 진짜로 내 첫 생카도 만들어주고 많이 와줘서 고맙고 나축하해주는 해시태그도 다 봤어!! 편지도 다읽었어 너무 감사해 이렇게 과분한사랑 많이 줘서 진짜 고맙고 하루종일 고맙다고만 하는것같지만 너무 고마운데 고맙다라는 표현보다 더한걸 못찾겠어서 계속 말하고있어..ㅎㅎ 내가 이렇게 사랑받고있구나 다시한번 느끼는 하루였어 비록 지금 생일이 지나갔지만 잊을수없는 경험시켜줘서 고마워!!!
messages.en: Thank you so much to all the WAVs who wished me a happy birthday. I was truly touched. You made my birthday a perfectly happy day, and it made me so, so happy. Thank you for making my very first birthday café event and for coming to visit it. I saw all the hashtags celebrating my birthday too!! I read every single letter as well. Thank you so much for giving me so much love—more than I feel I deserve. I feel like I've been saying 'thank you' all day, but I'm just so thankful, and I can't find any words stronger than 'thank you,' so I keep saying it...ㅎㅎ It was a day that reminded me once again just how loved I am. Even though my birthday has already passed, thank you for giving me such an unforgettable experience!!!
I came on purpose at this time.
Because I wanted us to welcome my birthday together.
I'm excited because I'm with you, Y/n.
I'm an adult, so you'll get arrested...
ㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ I'm one year older in Korean age now.

messages.ko: 하연이의 생일뿐만 아니라 8월의 첫날이어서 8월 내내 행운이 가득할 것 같습니다~~!
messages.en: Not only is it Hayeon's birthday, but it's also the first day of August, so I think August will be full of good luck~~!

messages.ko: 하연이 트리플에스로서 처음보내는 생일을 앞둔 기분이 어때??
messages.en: How does it feel spending your first birthday as tripleS?
Say it again once it hits midnight. 😄

messages.ko: 우리가 하연이 생일 축하해주는 첫 웨이브인거야 그럼...?
messages.en: Does that mean we're the first WAVs to wish you happy birthday...?
Who do you think will message me first?
Chaewon said she's going to be first.
What if neither of them sends anything?
Hey... you guys... didn't message me...?ㅎ (forcing a smile)
Isn't this the most birthday wishes you've ever received?
it was just my school friends and family.

messages.ko: 이제 날 축하해주고 사랑해주는사람이 이렇게나 많아졌다니
messages.en: Now there are so many people who celebrate me and love me.
That really makes me want to cry.
I don't even have that many school friends!!!!!
Please transfer the friendship fee to my bank account.
Okay, how much is it this month? 🥹
You're not very good at skating.

messages.ko: 카메라가 감히 내실력을 찍지 못했을뿐 ㅋ
messages.en: The camera just couldn't capture my true skills. ㅋ
Hayeon, your confidence is something else.

messages.ko: 시그널에서 백치미 연기하는 거 진짜 같더라 순간 믿을뻔
messages.en: Your airheaded acting in Signal looked so real I almost believed it.
Keeping up the cute dummy concept~~
Even though I'm actually a smart girl.

messages.ko: 빙판 위에서 갓 태어난 기린 연기를 그렇게 잘 할 줄 몰랐어!!
messages.en: I didn't know you could act like a newborn giraffe on ice so well!!

messages.ko: 하연아 혹시 받고 싶은 선물 있어?
messages.en: Hayeon, is there a gift you want?
Hayeon, I'm nervous. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 13 minutes left.
Why are you more nervous than I am?
I'm curious who'll send the first message.
Is there a prize for first place?

messages.ko: 근데 뭔가 내생일에 많은 이들이 집중하는것같아서
messages.en: It feels like so many people are focusing on my birthday.
Since it's a holiday, everyone have a happy Hayeon Day~
Wow, it's my birthday!!! Thank you. ㅠㅠㅠ

messages.ko: 하연아 생일 축하해 🤍🎂💖트리플에스의 올라운더 육각형 하연이가 되어줘서 고마워🥰
messages.en: Happy Birthday, Hayeon! 🤍🎂💖 Thank you for becoming tripleS' all-rounder, Hexagon Hayeon. 🥰
I've never received this many birthday wishes.
I almost cried while reading Joobin's letter~
Sohyun unnie was the first to give me a present.
A typo at such a precious moment!!!
I'm really weak when it comes to things like this.
I'll read every one of them.
Now I can finally go wash up.
Thank you so much for wishing me a happy birthday~~
I read all the Rekords and Fromm messages. ㅠㅠ
You even congratulated me during my live.
Thanks to you, I think this is going to be the best birthday...

messages.ko: Y/n 랑 함께하는 생일이라 최고긴하지만 ㅎ
messages.en: It's the best because I'm spending it with Y/n. ㅎ
It's my first birthday with Hayeon.
It's my first time looking forward to the day after tomorrow this much.
Is there anything you want as a birthday present?
What if I said I want Y/n?

messages.ko: 나 지금 얼굴에 리본 묶는 중이야
messages.en: I'm tying a ribbon around myself right now.
Make sure you tie it nicely.
Are you coming to pick me up?
Of course. I'm coming to pick up my present.
What do you want to do on your birthday?

messages.ko: 나는 한국에 갈 수 없기 때문에 케이크를 사서 집에서 축하할 거야
messages.en: I can't go to Korea, so I'll buy a cake and celebrate at home.
Then let's eat it together over Bluetooth.
Among all the people wishing me a happy birthday,
I'm happy that Y/n is one of them.
What should we do on my birthday?
Are you going to make seaweed soup for me too~?
Though... I'd probably make it better than you.
Hayeon, you didn't watch yesterday's live, did you..?
The one where you were cheating on me with Xinyu unnie?
Was she always like that with everyone?
Girls just naturally fall for me. ㅎ
She's just trying to make people jealous.
Hayeon, you should do a live with Sohyun too. ㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 안그래도 소현언니랑 일본에서 오붓하게 방쓰니까 좋더라 ㅋ
messages.en: Actually, it was nice sharing a room with Sohyun unnie in Japan. ㅋ
Chaewon would burst into tears if she found out.
She'd probably cry her eyes out.
Want me to tell you something cute?
I went to the company today.
The unnies were taking a break from practice.
Kim Chaewon was standing right next to me.
Then she looked at me and said,
"Hey, Jeong Hayeon... why didn't you say hi to me?"
She seriously likes me so much.
Although I went to Japan for work,
I got to visit a country I'd always wanted to go to,
It was so nice to meet you all. 🤍🤍🤍
I saw lots of Hexagons too,
What did you eat in Japan?
I tried beef tongue for the first time.
ㅎㅎ You were sweating a lot. ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
The day of the Mezamashi outdoor stage,
but the audience looked like they were having an even harder time,
What do you want to do in Japan next time?
You're paying for everything, right? ㅎㅎ
Thank you for being my fan.
Y/n, I really live thanks to you~🤍
I'm so happy that we have so much time ahead of us.
Please watch me become an adult,
and watch me continue to grow.
Stay by my side and watch over me.
I got back to the dorm
and no one else was home.
But the mood light in our room was on,
so I naturally thought someone was inside.
I was sitting in the living room,
and our bedroom door was wide open.
there was a shadow that kept passing by.
then a little while later I went into the room...
the way Shion unnie normally moves during her usual routine.
I got so scared that I went to Yubin unnie's room.
Do you know how scared I was?
This little baby was all by herself.
I came to get some encouragement.
It's just one of those days
when I wanted some. Please compliment me.
It's because it's late at night. ㅋㅋ
Sorry, I accidentally fell asleep for a bit..
Thank you for saying so many kind things.
Thank you for replying to me even though it's so late.
Nothing happened! ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ Did I make you worry?
Having so many people cheering me on
Even when I come here wanting encouragement without any particular reason,
for always being here for me.

messages.ko: Y/n 의 최애가 최고다 말할수있게 노력해볼게
messages.en: I'll do my best so you can proudly say your favorite is the best.
Not just at the concert, but for the rest of my life.
I'm saying this just in case you don't know.
You know I really love you, right??
To the point where I wonder if it's okay to be this sincere.
You might not see it that way, but just in case.
I'm worried you might take it lightly.

messages.ko: 날 좋아해주는 사람들 한명한명 진짜 다 소중해
messages.en: Every single person who likes me is truly precious.
Of course, everyone who loves tripleS is precious too.
Sorry for suddenly getting serious ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ, I just wanted to tell you.
It's not because something happened ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ.
If I don't say it at times like this, when will I?

messages.ko: 난 그냥 답답해 난 진짜 팬들이 소중하고
messages.en: I just feel frustrated. My fans are really precious to me.

messages.ko: 항상 잘해주고싶고 내말들에 진짜 힘이 났으면 좋겠고 그런데
messages.en: I always want to treat you well, and I hope my words can truly give you strength.
Just in case you didn't know!!!
If you already knew, then I'm glad...
I really want to do well.
I want to become someone you're proud of.
I always want you to cheer me on.
I'll become a better woman every single day...
Jeong Hayeon, can you take responsibility for me?

messages.ko: 내 청춘의 한 부분이 되어줘서 고마워!!!‘!!
messages.en: Thank you for becoming a part of my youth!!!
Why are you like this? ㅠㅠㅠㅠ I'm getting sad.

messages.ko: 나도 이럴 때 아니면 언제 말하나 싶긴 한데...트리플에스 S19로 있어줘서 고마워 하연아 🩵
messages.en: I feel like if I don't say it now, when will I... Thank you for being tripleS S19, Hayeon. 🩵
Thank you for becoming Hexagon too.
I'll continue working hard and enjoy all my future activities.
I just wanted to act spoiled.

messages.ko: 하연아 콘서트 못가는 WAV 에게 멘트 해줭
messages.en: Hayeon, say something to the WAVs who couldn't come to the concert.

messages.ko: 이번 콘서트 못온다고 우리 사이가 끝나!!?? 아니지!!
messages.en: Just because you couldn't come to this concert doesn't mean we're over!! Right!!
There will be more concerts later.
And we can keep talking like this!!
I promise we'll meet next time.
And for those who are coming, have lots of fun!!
Then I'm really going now. ㅋㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ

notices.text: Hayeon changed her Fromm profile picture.

messages.en: What do you think of this picture?
Which one should I use as my profile picture?
I got tired of the old one!!
Wow, it kind of feels like a fresh start.
I heard you've been flirting with Chaewon lately.
All I did was hold her hand.
Even when our eyes meet, she gets all flustered.
Just like you, Y/N, she fell for me too.

messages.ko: ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 나 요즘 고민중 너한테 넘어갈까말까
messages.en: ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ I've been wondering lately if I should fall for you or not.
ㅋ Too late. I've already won you over.

messages.ko: 정하연 맨날 유빈이만 찾는다고 채연이가 아쉬워하던데
messages.en: Chaeyeon said she's sad because you're always looking for Yubin.
Yubin unnie is kind of my meal buddy.
So we naturally end up sticking together.
I think it's not me who likes her anymore—she's the one who likes me now.
Am I really allowed to be this much of a heartbreaker?
I only have to glance at someone once and they're already falling for me.

messages.ko: 어린시절의 최애 하니 언니가 나없으면 못사는 사람이 되다니 짜릿할듯
messages.en: It must be thrilling that Hani unnie, your childhood favorite, has become someone who can't live without you.
It is kind of thrilling. ㅋ

messages.ko: 부럽다 나도 하연이가 나없으면 못사는 사람이 되었으면
messages.en: I'm jealous. I wish Hayeon couldn't live without me too.
I'm already that kind of person.
It's okay if you look at other girls for a second.
You just stay by my side.
Pfft... you cute little kitten. ㅎ
This is the first time I've seen a girl who's this possessive over me.
What do you think of a girl like this?
Now this is what real love looks like.
Hayeon, how exciting must it be every time you look in the mirror?
I can't really look at mirrors.
Because you're shining too brightly? ㅋ

messages.ko: 정하연 어떨때 보면 이쁜거이상으로 존잘 느낌 나던데
messages.en: Sometimes you're more than just pretty—you actually look really handsome.
I think Soomin has a crush on me.
Ah, what am I supposed to do?
Can I really call you 'handsome'...? ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Wow, there's nothing I don't know.

messages.ko: 완벽한 정하연 인생에 나라는 오점을 남기고 싶다 ㅋㅋ
messages.en: I want to leave a blemish on Jeong Hayeon's perfect life. ㅋㅋ
Then my life without you is only 95 points...
Because it doesn't have that missing five points. ㅋ

messages.ko: 뒤에 ㅋ만 없었으면 좀 멋있었는데 ㄲㅂ
messages.en: It would've sounded cooler without the 'ㅋ' at the end. So close.

messages.ko: 내가 대신 추천해드려도되나..난 오늘 치킨 먹었으니까 낼 치킨드세여!!
messages.en: Can I recommend something instead? I had chicken today, so you should have chicken tomorrow!!
Could you ask what kind of chicken it should be too??
Yep! Hot Bling and Original Fried! (If you like spicy food, I highly recommend Hot Bling!)
Could you ask if they can send a gift coupon too?
What kind of situation is this?
You two should just become friends.
I'll just step out of this conversation. ㄹㅌㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Alright, I think I should get going now!!

messages.ko: 오늘 진짜 넥스트랑 완전 힘들게 했더니
messages.en: Today was really tough because of NXT.
I only had Greek yogurt for dinner.
Am I really the 1 a.m. fairy?
I feel like I always show up at 1 a.m.
Don't you know The Lord of the Rings...?
The fan concert dress code is Gollum.
You should come dressed like that instead.
If you show up dressed as Gollum, you'll be the coolest person there. ㅋㅋ
Everyone would just stare at that person instead of us.

messages.ko: 아냐 그래도 난 너만 봐 ㅋ
messages.en: No, I'd still only look at you. ㅋ
You're saying you'd only see me~~

messages.ko: 요즘 팀에 감기 도는거 같던데 하연이는 괜찮니
messages.en: It seems like a cold's been going around the team lately. Are you okay?
I caught a sore throat too.
Are you that worried about me??
I'm kind of looking forward to seeing your sickly charm too...
Looks like you've fallen for me again?
Getting completely captivated by just one cough~~~

messages.ko: 근데 너 기침할 때 그렇게 안하잖아
messages.en: But that's not how you actually cough.
The sound at the end was fake.
The beginning was the real one.

messages.ko: 하연이는 길가다 말벌 보면 어떻게 대체 할래??
messages.en: What would you do if you saw a hornet on the street?

messages.ko: 만약 한국에 가서 하연을 만났다면 어떻게 해야 하나요? ㅋㅋ
messages.en: If I went to Korea and met Hayeon, what should I do? ㅋㅋ
Huh? By any chance... are you the Korean Princess????
Oh... are you an angel? My very own angel...?
I was actually drying my hair.
Ooooh, it's been a while since you washed your hair.

messages.ko: 머리 말린다는건.. 이제 잘준비를 끝냈단 얘긴데.,
messages.en: Drying your hair means you're finally ready for bed...
I should slowly get ready to sleep now.
When are you going to sleep, Y/N?
Looks like Hayeon doesn't even sleep because she's busy thinking about WAV.
No, I was asking what you were doing.

messages.ko: 오늘 뜬 팬콘 포스터 넘 예쁘드라~??
messages.en: The fan concert poster that came out today was so pretty~??
Isn't there anything different about me??

messages.ko: Y/n 대한 내 마음이 더 커졌잖아.
messages.en: My feelings for Y/N have gotten even bigger.
Why do you like me, Y/N?
Doesn't that make your heart flutter?
Why do you like me, Hayeon?
I like someone who loves me this much.

messages.ko: 아잉 자기야~ 이렇게 사람많은 곳에서 사랑고백을 하면 어떡해잉~🤭
messages.en: Aww, babe~ What am I supposed to do if you confess your love to me in such a crowded place~ 🤭
That's the first time I've ever heard that sound effect.
Hayeon, will you film a school vlog someday?
The day I go to school wearing makeup...

messages.ko: 하연이 학교에 화장하고 가면 전학생인줄 아는거 아니야???
messages.en: If you went to school wearing makeup, wouldn't everyone think you were a transfer student???
Are there any Hexagons at your school?
I think all of my teachers are Hexagons.
Whenever I go into the teachers' office, they sing our songs for me.
One of the teachers I had in my first year...
gathered the students from their class.
You're pretty even without makeup, but you've got to protect the kids' innocence.
You're a superstar. Superstar Jeong Hayeon.
Oh, stop it~ Come on~ Geez.
Let's make a nickname that only the two of us know.
So from today on, you're mine.

messages.en: The world's such a nice place now. I can just lie in my room and listen to Jeong Hayeon's cute voice.

messages.en: What should I do? I don't think I'd be able to love myself looking like that.
How's your diet going these days? Is it working?
Yeah. This time it's for real.

messages.en: Hayeon, I told you not to starve yourself. Eat lots of Hexagon love instead. 😑

messages.en: Hayeon, do you usually just wear your gym uniform to school?

Now I only wear it once in a while.
I hardly get to go to school these days. ㅠㅠ

messages.ko: 근데 너 진짜 세삼 더울 때 태어났다 하연아
messages.en: Hayeon, you really were born during the hottest time of the year.
so school was always on summer break.
When I was little, I always spent my birthday with my family.
I never got to celebrate with my friends.
We'll be your friends. Don't cry...
But there was one good thing.

messages.ko: 어릴때 데이터 다쓰면 한달에 한번씩 1일에 들어왔단말이야
messages.en: Back then, if I used up all my mobile data, it reset on the 1st of every month.
So it felt like getting mobile data as a birthday present.

messages.ko: 보통 본인 이야기 하고 귀엽다고 하나?
messages.en: Do people usually call themselves cute after telling a story about themselves?

and talking with Y/N makes me feel comfortable too.

messages.ko: 야이 바보야!! 나도야 이 바보야 흘긓ㄱㄱ

if we get the chance later,

messages.en: I'm about to eat some ice cream. What flavor should I get?

been learning Japanese since I was a trainee, seriously.

messages.ko: 내가 시험볼때 유일하게 자신있게 푼게 국어야!!
messages.en: The only subject I was ever confident taking exams in was Korean!!
The problem was that confidence was all I had.
So this is the kind of thing you find charming.

messages.ko: 항상 자신감 넘치게 하는 비결이 있어?

If you think positively about everything,
things tend to follow that mindset.
if I compliment myself and love myself,
other people end up seeing me that way too.
I think it's something like that.

messages.en: How do you overcome a slump, Hayeon?????
I don't try to overcome it.

I let myself be completely sad,
and after that, I feel okay again.
I tend to forget things easily,
so I'd rather let everything out, go through the pain, and then forget it.
That way it doesn't stay with me.
I think that's what works best for me.
What's kind of unusual about me is...
I overwrite it with an even stronger emotion.
I look up sad videos, watch them, and cry. ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
So you have to let it all out.
after talking with the Hexagons like this,
When you came in last on Golden Bell, what did you watch to forget about it?
That one was hard to forget.

you can look at each other and say,
